Method of Attack: Encrypts victim files using either a unique key downloaded from command & control server or one of 200 static offline keys
Encrypts files on each hard drive partition
Uses ransom note with PCID to indicate key type
Offline key uses built-in static keys for encryption
Online key requires reconstructing key from encrypted files
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with encrypted files by ODCODC ransomware
Indicators of Compromise: readthis.txt ransom note containing PCID like JANKO-16098513X1781 or JANKO-L3710254317
